nvitk.cluster.remote_submit¶

Optional SSH helper to run an emitted SGE bash script on a login node.

Functions¶

run_sge_script_ssh(→ bool)

Execute bash <script> on host via Paramiko. Returns True on exit 0.

run_sge_script_ssh_capture(→ tuple[int, str, str])

Execute bash <script> on the cluster; return (exit_code, stdout, stderr).

Module Contents¶

nvitk.cluster.remote_submit.run_sge_script_ssh(host: str, user: str, password: str, script_path: pathlib.Path | str, *, local_script_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, port: int = 22, timeout: float | None = None) → bool¶

Execute bash <script> on host via Paramiko. Returns True on exit 0.

nvitk.cluster.remote_submit.run_sge_script_ssh_capture(host: str, user: str, password: str, script_path: pathlib.Path | str, *, local_script_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, port: int = 22, connect_timeout: float | None = None) → tuple[int, str, str]¶

Execute bash <script> on the cluster; return (exit_code, stdout, stderr).

connect_timeout applies only to the SSH handshake. The remote bash run blocks until the script exits; there is no read timeout while the script runs (large cohort submissions may take many minutes).
